O my soul, the Lord cherishes all the beings as do father and mother their child.

There is but One God, By True Guru grace He is obtained.

Come and meet me, O mates, my venerable beloveds and let us meditate on Lord God's Name.

The mind, body and wealth all belongs to the Lord. What can anyone offer to Him in worship?

He alone merges into the Lord's lap, to whom the Merciful Master becomes compassionate.

Says Slave Nanak, joining the saints society, let us worship the Lord God's Name.

Prays Nanak, they alone are the true bankers, who have the Name in their lap.

Let us go and meet the slaves of God and meditate on the Lord Thus shall we obtain God's devotional service.

Let us forsake ego, worldly attachment and sin and dedicate to Him our body, wealth and this soul.

God's bride is a happy wife and she enjoys all pleasures.

in which in the mind and body of man is contained the Lord of supreme bliss.

Their nights and days pass in wranglings and they reflect not on the Guru's hymns.
20PY: The Creator has taken away their subtle intellect, and all their speech is corrupt.
The Creator has taken away from them their good understanding, so all their speech is sinful.
SCG6: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within them is desire, and the great darkness of ignorance.
However much is given to them, they are not sated. within them is avarice and great darkness of spiritual ignorance.
E4LQ: O Nanak, it is right to break with the self-willed manmukhs; to them, the love of Maya is sweet. ||1||
Nanak, it is good to break with the perverse, to whom the love of mammon is sweet.
1AZF: What can fear and doubt do to those, who have given their heads to the Creator, and to the True Guru?
What can fear and doubt, do to them, on whose head is the Satguru-Creator?
A0GY: He who has preserved honor from the beginning of time, He shall preserve their honor as well.
God, the Preserve, Himself preserve their honour.
LVTZ: Meeting their Beloved, they find peace; they reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.
Reflecting over the True Name they meet with their Beloved and obtain peace.
2E7G: O Nanak, I serve the Giver of Peace; He Himself is the Assessor. ||2||
Nanak I have served the peace giving Lord, who Himself is the Assayer.
V0SV: All beings are Yours; You are the wealth of all.
All men and lower animals are Yours and You are the capital of all.
KYFA: One to whom You give, obtains everything; there is no one else to rival You.
He, whom You givest, obtains everything. There is no other rival of Yours.
2F4L: You alone are the Great Giver of all; I offer my prayer to You, Lord.
You alone are the Beneficent Lord of all. My prayer is to You, O Master.
1WUJ: One with whom You are pleased, is accepted by You; how blessed is such a person!
You acceptest the prayer of him, with whom You are pleased. Blessed is such a person.
SPJH: Your wondrous play is pervading everywhere. I place my pain and pleasure before You. ||2||
Your wondrous play is manifest everywhere and my weal and woe are before You.
W43Y: The Gurmukhs are pleasing to the True Lord; they are judged to be true in the True Court.
The Guru-wards are pleasing to the True Lord and they are adjudged true in the True Court.
6Q25: The minds of such friends are filled with bliss, as they reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
In the mind of such friends of God, is bliss and they meditate on Guru's hymns.
WEA0: They enshrine the Shabad within their hearts; their pain is dispelled, and the Creator blesses them with the Divine Light.
They enshrine the Name in their mind. Their pain is dispelled and the Creator blesses them with the Divine Light.
ZU5T: O Nanak, the Savior Lord shall save them, and shower them with His Mercy. ||1||
Nanak, blessing them with His mercy the Saviour shall save them.
KAE7: Serve the Guru, and wait upon Him; as you work, maintain the Fear of God.
Wait upon and serve you the Guru and while toiling, abide in Lord's fear.
HRYE: As you serve Him, you will become like Him, as you walk according to His Will.
If you walkest according to His will, then shall you be like him, whom you servest.
C478: O Nanak, He Himself is everything; there is no other place to go. ||2||
Nanak, the Lord Himself is all in all and there is no other second, place to go to.
Z31S: You alone know Your greatness - no one else is as great as You.
My Master, Yours greatness, You alone knowest. None else is as great as You.
964A: If there were some other rival as great as You, then I would speak of him. You alone are as great as You are.
If some rival of Yours be as great as You, then, I would Name him, But as lofty as You, You alone are.
7XWB: One who serves You obtains peace; who else can compare to You?
He, who serves You, obtains peace. Who else can rival You?
EANC: You are all-powerful to destroy and create, O Great Giver; with palms pressed together, all stand begging before You.
My Beneficent Lord, You are All-powerful to make and unmake and with joined hands all are standing before You to beg.
5JG8: I see none as great as You, O Great Giver; You give in charity to the beings of all the continents, worlds, solar systems, nether regions and universes. ||3||
I see no one so great a Donor as You are. You givest alms to all the beings of all the continents, solar systems, nether lands, worlds and universes.
5THE: O mind, you have no faith, and you have not embraced love for the Celestial Lord;
If, O man you have not faith in the mind, embracest not love for the Lord,
PJDU: you do not enjoy the sublime taste of the Word of the Shabad - what Praises of the Lord will you stubborn-mindedly sing?
and enjoyest not the Name's relish, What praise of the Master shall you sing through forcing your mind?
4Z68: O Nanak, his coming alone is approved, who, as Gurmukh, merges into the True Lord. ||1||
Nanak, his advent alone is approved, who by Guru's instruction, merges into the True Lord.
5N1P: The fool does not understand his own self; he annoys others with his speech.
The fool understands not his ownself and annoys others by his speech.
7P0M: His underlying nature does not leave him; separated from the Lord, he suffers cruel blows.
The original nature of the foolish leaves him not. Separated from God, he bears blows.
R2QW: Through the fear of the True Guru, he has not changed and reformed himself, so that he might merge in the lap of God.
By True Guru's fear, he has not altered and reshaped his disposition, that he may remain merged in the Lord's lap.

SEWK: Night and day, his doubts never stop; without the Word of the Shabad, he suffers in pain.
Night and day his doubts never cease and without the Lord's Name, he writhes in pain.
8YKX: Sexual desire, anger and greed are so powerful within him; he passes his life constantly entangled in worldly affairs.
Lust, wrath and avarice are very powerful in his mind and his life ever passes in doing worldly affairs.
S399: His feet, hands, eyes and ears are exhausted; his days are numbered, and his death is immanent.
Tired are his feet, hands, eyes and ears. His days are numbered and his death is near.
ESW6: The True Name does not seem sweet to him - the Name by which the nine treasures are obtained.
The True Name appears not sweet to him, the Name by which the nine treasures are obtained.
JBPJ: But if he remains dead while yet alive, then by so dying, he truly lives; thus, he attains liberation.
If man, in life is dead and so dying lives, again, it is then that he attains salvation.
ਮੋਖ ਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਾ, ਮੁਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਰਾਜ਼
3EAA: But if he is not blessed with such pre-ordained karma, then without this karma, what can he obtain?
The mortals is not blessed with Lord's grace and without Lord's grace what can he obtain?
7XBW: Meditate in remembrance on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you fool; through the Shabad, you shall obtain salvation and wisdom.
O fool, meditate you on the Guru's hymns and through Gurbani you shall obtain salvation and wisdom.
X448: O Nanak, he alone finds the True Guru, who eliminates self-conceit from within. ||2||
Nanak, if you effacest your self-conceit from within, then alone shall you obtain the True Guru.
VRPK: One whose consciousness is filled with my Lord Master - why should he feel anxious about anything?
Why should he, within whose mind abides my Lord feel anxiety regarding anything?
0B9M: The Lord is the Giver of Peace, the Lord of all things; why would we turn our faces away from His meditation, even for a moment, or an instant?
God is the giver of the peace and the Lord of all the things. From His meditation, why should we turn our away, even for a moment and trice?
5DNT: One who meditates on the Lord obtains all pleasures and comforts; let us go each and every day, to sit in the Saints' Society.
He, who remembers God obtains all the comforts. We should daily go, sit and associate with the society of the pious persons.
XCYV: All the pain, hunger, and disease of the Lord's servant are eradicated; the bonds of the humble beings are torn away.
All woes, privations and diseases of God's slave are eradicated and bonds of the saints are torn asunder.
53AN: By the Lord's Grace, one becomes the Lord's devotee; beholding the face of the Lord's humble devotee, the whole world is saved and carried across. ||4||
By God's grace, one becomes God's devotee. The entire world ought to be saved by seeing the face of the Lord's pious person.
QB2C: Let that tongue, which has not tasted the Name of the Lord, be burnt.
May that tongue be burnt, which has not received the relish of Lord's name.
GRT3: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his tongue savors the Word of the Shabad. ||1||
Nanak, the tongue of him, who enshrines the Lord God in his mind, enjoys the taste of the Name.
ਰਸ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਭਿੱਜ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ
ZR31: Let that tongue, which has forgotten the Name of the Lord, be burnt.
Burnt be the tongue, which has forgotten the Name of God.
F4Y1: O Nanak, the tongue of the Gurmukh chants the Lord's Name, and loves the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Nanak, the tongue of the Guru-ware utters the Lord's Name and professes love for His Name.
CPRW: The Lord Himself is the Master, the servant and the devotee; the Lord Himself is the Cause of causes.
God Himself is the Lord, an attendant and a devotee. God Himself does and causes others to do.
63CR: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices. As He wills, so does He enjoin us.
God Himself beholds and Himself rejoices. As He wills, so does He engage the mortals in their tasks.
5VN0: The Lord places some on the Path, and the Lord leads others into the wilderness.
Some the Lord Himself puts on the right path and some the Lord leads astray into the wilderness.
ZNT5: The Lord is the True Master; True is His justice. He arranges and beholds all His plays.
God is the True Lord and true is His justice. He arranges and beholds all His plays.
HQ7T: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak speaks and sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||
By Guru's grace, servant Nanak utters and sings the praise of the True Lord.
DKSG: How rare is the dervish, the Saintly renunciate, who understands renunciation.
Rare is the one who understands saintliness, and there are but few saints.
085U: Cursed is the life, and cursed are the clothes, of one who wanders around, begging from door to door.
Accursed is the life and accursed his garb, who wanders about begging from houses to house.
KKBM: But, if he abandons hope and anxiety, and as Gurmukh receives the Name as his charity,
If he abandons hope and anxiety and receives the Name as his alms, through the Guru,
BSHL: then Nanak washes his feet, and is a sacrifice to him. ||1||
Nanak washes his feet and is a sacrifice to him.
0MCQ: O Nanak, the tree has one fruit, but two birds are perched upon it.
Nanak, you world-tree bears the fruit of love for mammon and upon it perch two birds (Guru-ward and self-ward persons.)
ZRU4: They are not seen coming or going; these birds have no wings.
These birds have no wings and are not seen while coming and going.
9G1X: One enjoys so many pleasures, while the other, through the Word of the Shabad, remains in Nirvaanaa.
The self ward enjoys the pleasures, while the other remain detached through the word of the Guru.
07F8: Imbued with the subtle essence of the fruit of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, the soul bears the True Insignia of God's Grace. ||2||
Imbued with the Nectar of the fruit of God's Name, the soul bears the true mark of God's grace, O Nanak.
TVP4: He Himself is the field, and He Himself is the farmer. He Himself grows and grinds the corn.
The Lord Himself is the field, Himself the farmer and Himself He, grows and grinds the corn.
TF03: He Himself cooks it, He Himself puts the food in the dishes, and He Himself sits down to eat.
Himself He cooks and Himself He gives dishes and puts food in them and He Himself sits down to eat it.
